evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API header in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h.
rationale: Clarifies the API contract to prevent undefined behavior in foreign language bindings when handling zero-length buffers. As noted in the description, btck_witness_stack_get_item_at can pass a null pointer via std::vector::data() for empty elements, which binding authors must handle to avoid crashes or UB when constructing slice views.
